title: How a Hair Dryer Works in 60 Seconds 💨🔥 #shorts
description:
A hair dryer is just a small fan blowing air over red-hot wire. A motor spins a fan that pulls air in at the back, coils of nichrome wire heat it up, and the hot, fast air evaporates the water in your hair. A thermal cutoff switches the heat off if things get too hot. Follow Inside 60 for a new "how it works" explained in 60 seconds.

#hairdryer #howitworks #shorts

steps.label: The Secret
steps.text: A hair dryer is really just a tiny *fan* blowing air over red-hot wire.

steps.label: Motor & Fan
steps.text: A small motor spins a *fan* that pulls air in through the back.

steps.label: Heating Coil
steps.text: The air flows over coils of *nichrome* wire, which glow hot when current runs through them.

steps.label: Hot Air
steps.text: Warm, fast air blasts out the front and *evaporates* the water in your hair.

steps.label: Settings
steps.text: Switches change the *fan speed* and how much current reaches the coil.

steps.label: Safety
steps.text: A *thermal cutoff* shuts off the heat if the dryer gets too hot.

steps.label: Recap
steps.text: Spin, heat, blow, *dry*. Follow Inside 60 for more.
